name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
body: I'm drawn to the Associate Case Manager role because I've been a patient inside the healthcare system myself, and I would love to be there helping other patients navigate it. That's a personal motivation, not a talking point, and it's what makes this role different from the account work I've done up to now.

What I bring is fifteen years of managing high-volume, detail-critical caseloads for individual clients: at Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month while holding sales and implementation targets above 100%, and at Solenzo I run concurrent client engagements today, keeping every interaction, timeline, and deliverable documented and current across CRM systems with strict data-hygiene discipline. That's the same rigor a fax queue, a payer call, and an accurate record demand, even though I want to be upfront that my experience is in CRM and account management, not payer-specific systems, medical terminology, or reimbursement processes directly. I learn fast and I'm used to picking up a new domain's specifics on the job.
I'd welcome the chance to talk about how that combination, real operational discipline plus a genuine personal reason to care about the outcome, could work for your Patient Services team.
